target.packaging: NSIS per-user installer and runtime-only portable ZIP; separate standalone corresponding-source ZIP

prerequisites.coreutils: timeout, sha256sum, mktemp, realpath, cp, mv, mkdir
prerequisites.visual_studio_code: optional for terminal builds; Remote WSL and godot-tools recommended for editing

environment_overrides.GODOT_BIN: explicit executable path or command; otherwise PATH godot then ~/.local/bin/godot
environment_overrides.GODOT_TEMPLATE_DIR: directory containing version.txt and Windows x86_64 templates
environment_overrides.GODOT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: positive integer; import/test default 120 seconds, export default 180 seconds

audio_assets.source_format: 14 generated mono PCM 16-bit WAV + 1 user-supplied mono MP3

supplied_asset.redistribution_rights: owner confirmed redistribution permission on 2026-11-09; included under GPL-3.0-only

art_assets.method: original procedural pixel atlas and bitmap alphabet

installer.name: NSIS
installer.compiler: makensis (override MAKENSIS_BIN; portable extraction supported via NSISDIR)
installer.scope: current user; no administrator; no network dependencies
installer.signing: unsigned release; trusted Authenticode identity required for verified publisher
